en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing three people in front of a round hut made of branches and thatch in an arid, hilly landscape. Two women sit at the entrance of the hut while another person stands to the left. Cooking pots and simple household items are on the ground. In the distant background on a hill there is a single rectangular white building. At the top left of the postcard is a printed caption in Portuguese that reads "Ribeira Bota (habitação indigena)."
